titles.title: Autumn Trees – The White Birch

description: Sinuous gray branches twist across the composition. Surrounding the branches are clouds of yellow and orange paint that denote clusters of autumn leaves. Small bits of grayish blue background are visible behind the tree.
title: Autumn Trees – The White Birch
